title: PeerJmapHandler separate trait enforces identity delivery at compile time
description: The two-trait design (JmapHandler for owner methods, PeerJmapHandler for peer methods) makes it a compile error to implement a peer handler that ignores the caller Identity — the type system forces the parameter to be present. The alternative (single trait with a CallerContext enum) would have required all 15+ owner handlers to pattern-match on something they never use, and the alternative (modify JmapHandler signature) would have broken all owner handlers. A future contributor might suggest 'simplifying to one trait' — resist: the separation is load-bearing for auth correctness.
